top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation (Crews, Deshaies, Handa) rests on a simple, quantitatively explicit principle, small-molecule-induced proximity to a ubiquitin ligase with measurable ternary-complex cooperativity, which makes pharmacology catalytic and reaches proteins with no active site. It is reproduced across many ligases, targets and laboratories, and the cereblon mechanism ties the designed PROTAC route to thalidomide-class glues, so the citation can be explained to a broad audience. Costs accepted: no approved PROTAC yet, Handa's contribution is target identification, and the three-person cap excludes Ciulli and others. Nitrogenase structure and ATP-electron coupling is next as a mature physical result with a narrowed citation; Buchwald-Hartwig is clean but overlaps the 2010 recognition; phase separation is still immature in living-cell tests; no award is last.
